name: Guardian formations page the client to their own action bar again
contract: Assault, Line and Tower Formation are shapeshift forms 37, 35 and 36, and the client's SpellShapeshiftForm.dbc gives
them BonusActionBar 1, 2 and 3 - the same paging rows 17 to 19 give the warrior stances - so entering a formation
pages the main bar and its hotkeys to that formation's own bar. An earlier change wrote 0 for all three into the
coa_client_shapeshift_form override table, which left the client on the main bar and is what 'Guardian
stances/formations no longer change to their respective bar' and 'Changing Guardian formation no longer switches to
that formation's configured skill bar' describe. The login patch stream sends each row of that table as
SMSG_PATCH_SPELL_SHAPESHIFT_FORM (0x0949): form id, bonus action bar, then the remaining 16 numeric fields and the
name. Expected: the client receives a row for each formation and its bonus action bar is the formation's own 2, 3
and 1. Socketless packet construction does not establish how the client pages its bar.

steps.label: Let the login patch stream finish
Line Formation's row reaches the client
Line Formation pages to bonus action bar 2
Tower Formation's row reaches the client
Tower Formation pages to bonus action bar 3
Assault Formation's row reaches the client
Assault Formation pages to bonus action bar 1
Assault Formation keeps its stance flags
